UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Non-PII root ownership anchor document for a landlord account to enforce relational subcollection access.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was initialized

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated

BillingSettings.title: BillingSettings
BillingSettings.description: Persistent previous-month water meter baselines and bank transfer details for the landlord.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the settings owner

prevTotal.description: Previous month building total water meter reading

prev201.description: Previous month Unit 201 water meter reading

prev202.description: Previous month Unit 202 water meter reading

accountInfo.description: Bank account instructions included in tenant SMS messages

seededBase.description: Whether the initial 2021-2024 baseline records have been seeded

BillingRecord.title: BillingRecord
BillingRecord.description: Monthly water utility settlement record stored in the cumulative audit ledger.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the record owner

billAmount.description: Total billed amount in KRW (nullable for incomplete historical entries)

billUsage.description: Total billed water usage in cubic meters (nullable)

usageTotal.description: Measured building total usage in cubic meters

usage201.description: Measured Unit 201 usage in cubic meters

usage202.description: Measured Unit 202 usage in cubic meters

usageShop.description: Calculated commercial shop usage in cubic meters

adjustmentTarget.description: Unit assigned the 500-KRW rounding shortfall based on cumulative std deviation (nullable)

addedAmount.description: Rounding shortfall adjustment added in KRW (nullable)

finalAmtSum.description: Final total collected across all units in KRW (nullable)

currTotal.description: Current building total meter reading (nullable for legacy records)

curr201.description: Current Unit 201 meter reading (nullable for legacy records)

curr202.description: Current Unit 202 meter reading (nullable for legacy records)

isBaseRecord.description: True for initial 2021-2024 historical ledger rows

/users/{userId}.description: Root non-PII anchor document for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User's persistent previous-month meter baselines and bank transfer account details (document id: main).

/users/{userId}/records/{recordId}.description: User's cumulative monthly water utility settlement records.
